userPromptSubmitted.bash: INPUT=$(cat); echo "[Hook] User prompt submitted:"; echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.prompt' | head -c 100
userPromptSubmitted.powershell: $input = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Output '[Hook] User prompt submitted:'; Write-Output $input.prompt.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(100, $input.prompt.Length))

preToolUse.bash: INPUT=$(cat); TOOL=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.toolName'); echo "[Hook] Pre-tool: $TOOL"; echo '{"permissionDecision": "allow"}'

postToolUse.bash: INPUT=$(cat); TOOL=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.toolName'); RESULT=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.toolResult.resultType'); echo "[Hook] Post-tool: $TOOL - $RESULT"

errorOccurred.bash: INPUT=$(cat); ERROR=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.error.message'); echo "[Hook] Error occurred: $ERROR"
